method: Read and SHA-256-verify registry layers without execution. Inventory installed dpkg packages and resolve copyright symlinks; record JRE legal notices. Helper versions from pinned Dockerfile; license texts fetched at version tags where identified.
limitations: This is an external-use component/notice inventory, not a complete transitive binary SBOM or image redistribution clearance. Package notice labels may describe source files not present in installed binaries. Paperclip version/license verified at v3.0.4 from the pinned Paper build source. Spark notice reviewed on upstream master; exact published-artifact/transitive dependency review remains a release gate.

helper_projects.delivery: Included by upstream Paper; not an added GameStack plugin
